surface.role: Every page, rail, header and terminal chrome background; also text on the primary accent button

surface-raised.role: Dialogs, menus, inputs and selected rows only; never a second page background

ink.role: All body text, names, headings, field labels and action labels

ink-muted.role: Secondary metadata only: path, timestamp and shortcut annotation; never body text or field labels

border.role: Unfocused control and pane outlines only; never a rule around every content row

accent.role: Primary button fill, selected marker, active-tab underline and keyboard-focus outline; never liveness

running.role: Running state text only; no indicator, including in-flight operations

ready.role: Ready glyph and label only; green never means keyboard focus or generic success

lost.role: Lost glyph and label only; do not infer an error from a slow connection

dead.role: Dead glyph/label and failed-operation or destructive-confirmation text; never ordinary selection

archived.role: Archived glyph and label only; retained history

limit-reached.role: Limit reached glyph and label only; no decorative purple

type-caption.role: 12px: secondary metadata only; one terminal row

type-body.role: 14px: body, fields, buttons and session/task names; one terminal row

type-heading.role: 16px: section and pane headings; one bold terminal row

type-title.role: 20px: dialog title; one bold terminal row

type-display.role: 24px: zero-session or unavailable-screen heading only; one bold terminal row

space-1.role: Glyph-to-label gap; one horizontal terminal cell

space-2.role: Related controls and row inset; one horizontal terminal cell

space-3.role: Panel/dialog inset; two horizontal terminal cells

space-4.role: Section separation; one vertical blank terminal row

radius-control.role: Buttons and inputs only; square terminal controls

radius-dialog.role: Dialogs and menus only; rounded terminal overlay
